EAM Jaishankar Calls for Zero Tolerance on Merchant Ship Attacks

External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar stated that attacks on merchant ships are unacceptable and that international waters must be safe. Speaking at an ASEAN forum, he emphasized the need for "zero tolerance for terrorism." The remarks addressed recent incidents involving merchant vessels.
